name: Hibernal-Nunatak
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past exposed planetary core, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
radiation hotspot bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
